scope_note: Alexander's meters are pulse, amber and self; Reese's are load and the reese.* names. self, amber, the Word and who was left carry into dr-tox-fall. Numbers are design values for the prototype; units in The Cage are invented (marks, drops of reagent A9) and describe no real procedure, dose or route.

state.name: pulse
state.description: Alexander's heart rate as pressure, 0 to 100. +12 per dart drawn from the shunt, +8 when seen, +15 on a hit, +3 per second of sprint; -2 per second standing still in cover. Floor 20, or 40 when amber is 0 at a chapter start. At 100 the Toxin State takes the controls (bible Part VI, Dr. Tox section 3).

state.name: amber
state.description: Doses of the radioactive cage on hand, 0 to 6. Made in The Cage. One is taken at each Alexander chapter start; each Toxin State burns 2 (the cost model, bible Part IX Q1, adopted).

state.name: amber_quality
state.description: The last batch from The Cage. leaky: the endpoint was missed short (pulse floor +10 next chapter). steady: on the endpoint. hot: overshot (one fewer dose).

state.name: self
state.description: What is left of the man, 0 to 100. Each Toxin State event takes 15, or 10 if its Aftermath is reconstructed; the Green ending takes 25 more. Never restored (bible Part IX Q2, adopted). Below 70 his panel captions lose words. Carries into Fall.

state.name: toxin_events
state.description: Every Toxin State event. trigger is pulse, scripted or hit; reconstructed is true once its Aftermath page is solved.

state.name: toxin_in_escape
state.description: Pulse reached 100 during the escape (s2_panel_3). Decides the Green in the Archive ending.

state.name: first_dose_taken
state.description: The fifteen-year-old drove his first dose (s3_injection_first).

state.name: river.children_met
state.description: Children of the river town the five-year-old Alexander played beside, 0 to 4 (s3_river_town).

state.name: river.details
state.description: The one detail the player noticed about each child in the river town: Dale's two-wheeler with one training wheel, June's chalk numbers, the Ostrowski twins' matching scabs, Hollis's jar of minnows. Read back in Fiche.

state.name: fiche.own_file_found
state.description: Alexander found SUBJECT CMXCIX on the fiche (s1_fiche_1).

state.name: fiche.names_read
state.description: Names of the 999 read aloud from the fiche before security came, 0 to 999 (in practice up to about 60).

state.name: fiche.children_found
state.description: Children from the river town found on the fiche by their detail, 0 to 4.

state.name: hunch
state.description: RCC plates found in break-ins (the hardware still reads RCC, bible Part III, Terminology Rule, Exception), 0 to 3. At 3 the pin board in his flat is complete; the hike that ends in the cavern begins.

state.name: window.slack
state.description: Seconds of slack in the last break-in window found on The Window, 0 to 90. The Panel run starts with pulse 20 plus (90 - slack)/3.

state.name: panel.darts_drawn
state.description: Darts drawn from the shunt across all Panel runs.

state.name: panel.seen
state.description: Times Alexander was seen across all Panel runs.

state.name: reese.bond_cally
state.description: Reese's bond with Cally, 0 to 100, raised in Sky Room and Cat's Cradle.

state.name: reese.bond_carmy
state.description: Reese's bond with Carmy, 0 to 100.

state.name: reese.bond_rolan
state.description: Reese's bond with Rolan, 0 to 100.

state.name: cradle.figures_made
state.description: String figures the four children finished together across Cat's Cradle.

state.name: arena.held_seconds
state.description: How long Reese held the blade before dropping it. The arena waits; it never accepts another input (s3_arena).

state.name: arena.weapon_dropped
state.description: Reese threw down his weapon. Always true by the cut at the seam; the arena is played as the refusal.

state.name: reese.mirror_answer
state.description: What Reese answers at the mirror when the woman says he looks like he is supposed to: nothing, or 'For HOPE?'

state.name: reese.flinches
state.description: Times the leash fired: HOPE signalled a flashback and Reese felt it as gratitude (bible Part VIII Scene 2 III). Carries into Fall.

state.name: load
state.description: Toxins Aegis has absorbed, 0 to 100. Absorbing a canister cloud adds 20; each metre of hard-light wall spends 2.

state.name: other_hero.met
state.description: Reese met the unnamed other hero in the lower ring (bible Part VIII Scene 2 VI).

state.name: barrier.penned
state.description: People penned in by Aegis's walls during the escort in (s2_barrier_1).

state.name: barrier.penned_names
state.description: Each person penned, by name, with the one want they say through the wall.

state.name: barrier.transport_through
state.description: The transport reached the supply corridor's far gate.

state.name: barrier.released
state.description: Pen walls Reese dropped on the way out (s2_barrier_2), at the cost of the transport's time. Carries into Fall.

state.name: reese.word
state.description: What Reese answers when Nell Okafor says 'RCC sent you' over a plate stamped RCC (s3_lower_ring_after): 'HOPE sent me', 'RCC sent me', or nothing. The Terminology Rule as a flag (bible Part III).

state.name: reese.said_rcc
state.description: The first time Reese says 'RCC' is recorded (bible Part III; Part VI, Aegis, voice note). Carries into Fall.

state.name: cycle41.watched
state.description: Alexander stayed until Cycle 41 opened her eyes (s3_printer_room).

state.name: took_spec_sheet
state.description: Alexander tore the terminal's printout and kept it. Decides The Spec Sheet ending.

state.name: knows_aegis
state.description: Alexander has read the name AEGIS and kept it. Set with took_spec_sheet; the bible's own path has him not know the name (Part VIII Scene 3).

state.name: security_knows_face
state.description: The printer room's camera logged his face while he tore the printout.

state.name: observers_choice
state.description: At the alarm the Observers open their cells' inner door for him. with_them: he goes through with them. left_them: he takes the stair alone and seals the door behind him.

state.name: aftermath.solved
state.description: Aftermath pages reconstructed in full.

state.name: claimed_snakehead
state.description: Alexander returned and lit the amber work lamp in the bunker.
